ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface area with high-intensity (white) pixel clusters; estimated ratio of 85% low-intensity to 15% high-intensity visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity black field across the central and medial lobes; high-intensity white clusters localized at the lateral tips and trailing edges; sparse multi-directional white linear streaks distributed across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel-calculated angle of 52 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations along the trailing edge; pixel amplitudes of indentations increase toward the distal tips, presenting a ragged, saw-tooth profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve along the trailing edge leading to pointed, upward-tapering lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of small, circular white pixel groups concentrated at the distal lateral margins of both lobes, suggesting barnacle attachment sites or historical colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of white, non-parallel linear and curvilinear streaks (rake marks) crossing both lobes; highest density observed on the right lobe with multiple intersecting paths.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive scarring across the entire visible ventral surface; irregular ragged margins at the trailing edge consistent with physical trauma or environmental wear.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent, thick white curvilinear mark on the right lobe; distinct white calcified appearance at the terminal tips.
